input.question: When was Rutherford High School established?

documents.text: Rutherford High School (New Jersey) Rutherford High School is a comprehensive four-year public high school located in Rutherford, in Bergen County, New Jersey, United States, operating as part of the Rutherford School District. The original structure was built in 1922 and expanded in 1938, 1957 and 2005. Rutherford High School is overseen by the New Jersey Department of Education and has been accredited by the Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Secondary Schools since 1940. As of the 2015-16 school year, the school had an enrollment of 750 students and 67.3 classroom teachers (on an FTE basis),
